scripts.main:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
root=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
old=json.loads((root/'Audit/verify-internal-hash-map-2026-10-22.json').read_text())
inputs=Path('/tmp/sirkit_internal_hash_20261022/official');outputs=Path('/tmp/sirkit_internal_hash_20261022/reference_outputs')
expected={x['case']:x for x in old['official_expected_outputs']};data={'date':'2026-10-26','source_hashes':json.loads((base/'frozen-hashes.json').read_text()),'input_records':[],'runs':[]}
for x in old['official_inputs']:
 ip=inputs/x['name'];op=outputs/(x['name']+'.out');assert sha(ip)==x['sha256']and sha(op)==expected[x['name']]['sha256']
 data['input_records'].append({'case':x['name'],'input_path':str(ip),'input_sha256':x['sha256'],'input_bytes':ip.stat().st_size,'expected_path':str(op),'expected_sha256':sha(op),'expected_bytes':op.stat().st_size})
assert len(data['input_records'])==20
submission=(root/'Verify/current/submissions/internal_hash_map.cpp').read_text()
(base/'checked.cpp').write_text(submission.replace('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n','',1));(base/'skip.cpp').write_text(submission)
expected_example=b'1 0\nmissing\nready 1 1\n0 1\n2 2\nready\n1 1\n0 0\nmissing\n1 1\n'
for name,cc in [('gcc',['/usr/bin/g++']),('clang',['/usr/bin/clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'])]:
 for skip in [False,True]:
  cfg=name+('-skip'if skip else'-checked');flags=['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']if skip else[]
  for kind in ['main','example','shared']:
   src=base/('skip.cpp'if skip else'checked.cpp')if kind=='main'else root/'Examples/internal_hash_map_example.cpp'if kind=='example'else root/'Verify/current/tests/internal_hash_shared_guard_test.cpp'
   exe=base/(cfg+'-'+kind);cmd=['taskset','-c','8',*cc,'-std=c++23','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-pedantic',*flags,str(src),'-o',str(exe)]
   p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,timeout=180);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr.decode();entry={'config':cfg,'kind':kind,'compile':cmd,'diagnostics':p.stderr.decode(),'exit':0}
   if kind=='main':
    entry['cases']=[]
    for case in data['input_records']:
     with open(case['input_path'],'rb')as ip:q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','12',str(exe)],stdin=ip,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
     assert q.returncode==0 and hashlib.sha256(q.stdout).hexdigest()==case['expected_sha256'],(cfg,case['case'],q.stderr.decode())
     entry['cases'].append({'name':case['case'],'output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(q.stdout).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(q.stdout)})
   else:
    q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','12',str(exe)],capture_output=True,timeout=60);assert q.returncode==0,q.stderr.decode()
    if kind=='example':assert q.stdout==expected_example,q.stdout
    entry['stdout']=q.stdout.decode()
   data['runs'].append(entry);(base/'main-validation-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(cfg,kind,'PASS',flush=True)
assert all(sha(root/p)==h for p,h in data['source_hashes'].items());data['source_unchanged']=True;(base/'main-validation-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print('20 INPUTS / EXAMPLE / SHARED GUARD PASS',flush=True)

limitations: 現在版のオンラインAC・時間は未取得。旧Verifyや過去のローカル測定を現在版のオンラインACへ読み替えない。
公式generator由来入力の照合とオンライン判定は別。現在サーバーの全hiddenケースとの一致を保証する意味ではない。
内部用整数キー表であり削除・反復子・複合キーはない。それらは公開汎用HashMapの用途。
find_nonemptyは容量確保済みが前提。factory/for_eachで表を変更する使い方は契約外。
時刻由来の乗算hashは期待計算量の実装で、攻撃的な入力への最悪O(1)保証はない。
LSanは既存ptrace制約に合わせdetect_leaks=0。ASan/UBSanと別途の資源所有・確保数復帰試験を通過。
今回本体を変更しておらず、追加の速度向上を主張しない。
